do_list: Lead with product performance proof in real-life use.
Use inclusive casting and shade/skin diversity across creative.
Anchor messaging in direct, energetic, urban language.
Include social impact or sustainability references when relevant.
dont_list: Avoid vague luxury language that hides product utility.
Avoid narrow representation in visual and copy examples.
Avoid claims without context, proof point, or source.
source_highlights: We’re from New York, and in this city you have to be ready for anything.
We make no-hassle, high-performance makeup tried and tested on our streets.
Makeup for every look, style, skin tone.
Makeup that stands up to the city.
Makeup Make Change is our social impact platform with two focuses: Brave Together and Conscious Together.
Brave Together supports people experiencing anxiety and depression.
Conscious Together sets goals across production, packaging, formula and disposal.
Partnership with The Recycling Partnership supports recycling access and contamination reduction.
Mission: innovative, accessible and effortless cosmetics.
Maybelline is a global makeup brand available in 120+ countries.
